figurative_meaning_bn: যে কুবুদ্ধির প্রয়োগে নিজেই ধ্বংস হয়
figurative_meaning_en: A foolish idea or plan that leads to one's own destruction
similar_in_english: Cutting off one's nose to spite one's face
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার ঘরপোড়া বুদ্ধির ফলে সে নিজের ব্যবসা নষ্ট করে ফেলল।
এই ঘরপোড়া বুদ্ধি করে তুমি নিজেকেই ক্ষতি করছ।
example_sentences_in_english: His burnt-house wisdom caused him to ruin his own business.
By using this self-destructive idea, you're only harming yourself.
note: This idiom metaphorically refers to wisdom gained too late, after a personal disaster like a house fire, emphasizing hindsight folly in Bengali oral tradition.
